product_overview: PDF Studio is a local-first, RTL-first Arabic PDF desktop application for converting, organizing, securing, and enhancing PDFs and images without uploading documents to external servers. It runs in Electron and standard browser environments with strict security isolation and offline processing.
core_goals: Provide a centralized drag-and-drop hub for routing PDFs and images into the correct tool
Enable offline PDF manipulation and conversion entirely on the client side
Support Arabic-first and RTL-friendly workflows across all tools
Deliver high-quality document processing features such as scan cleanup, OCR, compression, signing, and protection
Allow flexible export formats including PDF, ZIP, images, and plain text while preserving user privacy

features.name: Central Hub
features.description: A drag-and-drop entry point that classifies incoming files and routes users to the appropriate PDF or image tool.
user_flows: POST #hub-browse with multiple PDF files -> Receive intelligent classification -> GET #view-merge route suggestion -> Receive merge workspace with files loaded

POST #hub-drop with a single PDF file -> Receive tool suggestions for edit/organize/watermark/numbers/compress/split/crop/protect/ocr/extract-images/rasterize -> GET selected tool route -> Receive corresponding workspace
POST #hub-drop with image files -> Receive auto-routing to scan or images-to-PDF -> GET #view-scan or #view-images -> Receive image intake workspace
POST #hub-drop with unsupported file type -> Receive validation error message -> Remain on #view-start with no tool routing

features.name: Document Scanner
features.description: Imports images from file or clipboard, detects document boundaries, corrects perspective, applies filters, and exports one or more scanned pages as PDF.
user_flows: POST #view-scan with imported image -> Receive 4-corner boundary detection -> Adjust quadrilateral handles -> Apply perspective correction -> Export multi-page PDF with scanned output
POST #view-scan with clipboard image paste -> Receive scan workspace with detected page edges -> Apply grayscale or high-contrast filter -> Export cleaned page as PDF
POST #view-scan with blurry or non-document image -> Boundary detection fails -> Receive detection/preview error -> User can retry import or adjust corners manually

features.name: Images to PDF
features.description: Converts batches of supported image formats into a formatted PDF with configurable page size, margins, and orientation.
user_flows: POST #view-images with JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/BMP/TIFF/HEIC image list -> Receive batch preview and layout controls -> Select A4 portrait with margins -> Generate combined PDF
POST #view-images with mixed images -> Receive image list and auto-fit layout option -> Choose Letter landscape -> Export PDF successfully
POST #view-images with unsupported image format -> Receive file type validation error -> No PDF generation occurs

features.name: Merge PDFs
features.description: Combines multiple PDFs into one lossless merged document with drag-and-drop ordering.
user_flows: POST #view-merge with multiple PDFs -> Receive file cards in merge workspace -> Reorder cards via drag-and-drop -> Generate single merged PDF
POST #view-merge with multiple PDFs -> Reorder files incorrectly or leave none selected -> Receive validation error about missing or invalid input -> Merge action is blocked

features.name: Organize Pages
features.description: Displays page thumbnails for reordering, rotation, deletion, and saving a modified PDF arrangement.
user_flows: POST #view-organize with a PDF -> Receive thumbnail grid of pages -> Drag pages into new order -> Rotate selected pages 90 degrees -> Delete one page -> Save updated PDF
POST #view-organize with an encrypted or unreadable PDF -> Receive load error -> Thumbnail grid is not created -> User is prompted to fix or unlock the file first

features.name: Split PDF
features.description: Splits a PDF into separate documents by page, page count, or custom ranges and exports as PDFs or ZIP.
user_flows: POST #view-split with a PDF -> Select split every 1 page -> Receive generated per-page PDF outputs -> Download as ZIP archive
POST #view-split with a PDF -> Enter custom ranges 1-3, 5, 7-10 -> Receive grouped split jobs -> Export individual PDF files
POST #view-split with invalid range text -> Receive range parsing error -> Split job does not start

features.name: Compress PDF
features.description: Reduces PDF file size using DPI presets, JPEG quality controls, and optional grayscale conversion.
user_flows: POST #view-compress with a PDF -> Select 72 DPI and JPEG quality setting -> Receive optimized output preview and size comparison -> Download compressed PDF
POST #view-compress with a PDF -> Enable grayscale and set invalid quality value -> Receive validation error -> Compression export is prevented

features.name: Watermark PDF
features.description: Adds customizable text watermarks with configurable appearance, rotation, and placement on PDF pages.
user_flows: POST #view-watermark with a PDF -> Enter watermark text and set opacity, font size, rotation, and 9-point position -> Apply watermark preview -> Export stamped PDF
POST #view-watermark with a PDF -> Set rotation outside allowed range or leave text blank -> Receive validation error -> Watermark cannot be applied

features.name: Page Numbers
features.description: Stamps page numbers using Arabic, Eastern Arabic, Roman, or custom templates with flexible placement and offsets.
user_flows: POST #view-numbers with a PDF -> Choose Arabic numeral format and footer-center placement -> Set starting number and margins -> Generate numbered PDF -> Download result
POST #view-numbers with a PDF -> Enter invalid template or unsupported settings -> Receive formatting validation error -> Number stamping is blocked

features.name: Rasterize PDF
features.description: Converts PDF pages into image sequences in PNG, JPEG, or WebP at selectable DPI scales for export individually, as ZIP, or to a folder.
user_flows: POST #view-rasterize with a PDF -> Select PNG output and 2x scale -> Render pages to bitmap images -> Download images as ZIP
POST #view-rasterize with a PDF -> Select 3x scale and folder export without permission -> Receive export path or permission error -> Rasterization output is not saved

features.name: Sign PDF
features.description: Captures signatures and stamps them onto PDF pages with move, scale, and delete controls before flattening the result into the final document.
user_flows: POST #view-sign with a PDF -> Draw a signature on the canvas -> Place signature stamp on page -> Add optional date stamp -> Flatten and export signed PDF
POST #view-sign with a PDF -> Attempt to place an empty signature or invalid stamp -> Receive validation error -> Signed export is blocked

features.name: Protect and Unlock PDF
features.description: Encrypts PDFs with AES-256 permissions or decrypts/removes restrictions from password-protected files using local processing.
user_flows: POST #view-protect with an unprotected PDF -> Enter user and owner passwords and permissions -> Encrypt with AES-256 -> Download protected PDF
POST #view-protect with a password-protected PDF -> Enter correct password -> Decrypt and remove restrictions -> Download unlocked PDF
POST #view-protect with a protected PDF -> Enter wrong password -> Receive authentication error -> Unlock operation fails

features.name: Crop PDF
features.description: Lets users visually define crop rectangles with resize handles and apply them to one or all pages.
user_flows: POST #view-crop with a PDF -> Drag crop box handles to desired boundaries -> Apply crop to active page -> Save cropped PDF
POST #view-crop with a PDF -> Enter invalid crop coordinates or out-of-bounds selection -> Receive clipping validation error -> Crop export is blocked

features.name: Extract Images
features.description: Extracts embedded raster images from PDF pages and supports thumbnail review, single download, and batch ZIP export.
user_flows: POST #view-extract-images with a PDF -> Receive thumbnail gallery of embedded images -> Download a selected image -> Export remaining images as ZIP
POST #view-extract-images with a PDF containing no extractable images -> Receive empty gallery or no-images message -> Batch export is unavailable

features.name: OCR Text Recognition
features.description: Recognizes Arabic and English text from PDFs or images using local OCR and outputs searchable text overlays or plain text.
user_flows: POST #view-ocr with a PDF or image -> Select ara and eng OCR languages -> Run recognition in worker -> Generate searchable PDF overlay -> Download result
POST #view-ocr with a low-quality scan -> OCR returns poor recognition or no text -> Receive recognition warning -> Plain text export may be incomplete

features.name: PDF Editor
features.description: Provides protected-scope editing, markup, and annotation capabilities for PDFs.
user_flows: POST #view-edit with a PDF -> Open editor workspace -> Add markup or annotation -> Save edited PDF
POST #view-edit with a restricted document or unsupported edit operation -> Receive protected-scope or permission error -> Editing action is denied

features.name: Central Hub
features.description: Drag-and-drop file intake, intelligent file classification (PDF vs images), routing to appropriate tools.

features.name: Document Scanner
features.description: 4-corner document boundary detection, perspective quadrilateral transform, color/grayscale/binary filters, super-resolution upscale, multi-page PDF generation.

features.name: Images to PDF
features.description: Batch conversion of images (JPEG, PNG, WebP) into PDF with custom page sizes (A4, Letter, Auto), margins, and orientation.

features.name: Merge PDFs
features.description: Drag-and-drop multi-file reordering using SortableJS and lossless PDF merging.

features.name: Organize Pages
features.description: Visual thumbnail grid, page drag-and-drop reordering, 90/180/270 degree rotation, single page deletion, and PDF saving.

features.name: Split PDF
features.description: Split by individual pages, split every N pages, or split by custom comma-separated page ranges into individual PDFs or a ZIP archive.

features.name: Compress PDF
features.description: Canvas raster downsampling with preset DPI levels (72, 144, 200) and JPEG quality compression.

features.name: Watermark PDF
features.description: Visual text watermark stamping with customizable font size, opacity, rotation angle (-45 to 45 deg), color, and 9-point grid positioning.

features.name: Page Numbers
features.description: Page number stamping with Arabic/Eastern/Latin numeral formats, template text, starting offset, margins, and 6-point header/footer alignment.

features.name: Rasterize PDF
features.description: High-fidelity PDF page rasterization into PNG, JPEG, or WebP image sequences with 1x, 2x, or 3x DPI scale, exported individually or in ZIP/folder.

features.name: Sign PDF
features.description: Signature capture canvas with stroke smoothing, pre-saved signature stamps, text/date stamps, interactive drag-and-resize placement, and flattened export.

features.name: Protect and Unlock PDF
features.description: Password encryption (AES-256) and decryption / password stripping using QPDF WebAssembly.

features.name: Crop PDF
features.description: Visual bounding box crop selection with 8 resize handles, page-by-page or batch application, and viewport coordinate clipping.

features.name: Extract Images
features.description: Lossless stream extraction of embedded images (JPEG, PNG, JP2) from PDF XObjects, thumbnail gallery, and batch ZIP export.

features.name: OCR Text Recognition
features.description: Client-side optical character recognition for Arabic and English text using Tesseract.js, producing searchable text overlays or plain text export.

features.name: PDF Editor
features.description: Interactive PDF editing, annotations, text overlays, and page markup (PROTECTED SCOPE - R3).
